description:
Updates only the properties present in the body. Invoices already saved keep the text
they were saved with: renaming or archiving an option never changes an invoice.

- **Rename:** `value` replaces the text. If another option of the field in the same scope
  — the same customer, or the common options for a common one — is equivalent to the new
  text (ignoring case, accents and repeated spaces), the answer is `409` with
  `CUSTOM_FIELD_OPTION_DUPLICATE` and nothing changes.
- **Archive or reactivate:** `is_archived`. Options are never deleted.

BeeL API endpoint: PATCH /v1/companies/{company_id}/custom-fields/{key}/options/{option_id} (reference: https://docs.beel.es)

CustomFieldKey.description: Identifier of the custom field within the company, chosen when the field is created: lowercase letters, digits and `_`, up to 64 characters. It never changes. BeeL. gives it no meaning of its own.

PatchCustomFieldOptionRequest.description: JSON Merge Patch of an option: an omitted property is left as it is. Neither property can be cleared. The customer an option belongs to cannot be changed.

value.description: New text of the option. Leading and trailing spaces are removed. Invoices already saved keep the text they were saved with.

company_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the company the operation acts on — its identifier, not its NIF. It is the only source of context: the account that owns it is derived from it, and the `BeeL-Active-Company` header plays no part. A company you do not reach answers `403`, and so does a company that does not exist, so the existence of a company in another account is never disclosed.

key.description: Key of the custom field: lowercase letters, digits and `_`, up to 64 characters. A key outside that format answers `422`.

name: beel_patch_custom_field_option
